title: 花瓣乘客安心休息
prompt:

Input 1: porch environment layout and watercolor style ONLY; keep the same low table, shallow terracotta dish, flowerpot to the left, and warm window lamp. Input 2: continuity reference ONLY for the single LEAF_01 with its single dry PETAL_01 and the single PEBBLE_01 outside the dish. Preserve exact placements. Do not copy any rabbit from any other source.
Visible characters: none. Exact total number of visible characters: 0. No people, rabbits, animals, hands, or body parts.
Scene continuity: the same porch table and shallow terracotta dish at night; warm house light glows in the same position.
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: quiet close view of the leaf boat fully docked at the inner rim of the water-filled terracotta dish; the pink petal remains dry in the boat; the small flat pebble rests on the tabletop outside the dish, directly opposite the docking point.
Prop rules: exactly one leaf, one dry petal, one pebble. The pebble is outside the water. No extra props.
Vertical 9:16 gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, soft edges, muted natural colors. Keep the important dish and all three small story props in the upper 68%, bottom 32% low-detail space for subtitles. No words, text, watermark, logo, collage, panels, or extra characters. No new story events.
